title: Jesus Greater Than Moses, Warning Against Unbelief

questions.question: Therefore, holy brothers, you who share in a heavenly calling, consider Jesus, the apostle and high ____ of our confession,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:1 (ESV): "Therefore, holy brothers, you who share in a heavenly calling, consider Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession,"

questions.question: who was faithful to him who appointed him, just as ____ also was faithful in all God's house.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:2 (ESV): "who was faithful to him who appointed him, just as Moses also was faithful in all God's house."

questions.question: For Jesus has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses—as much more glory as the ____ of a house has more honor than the house itself.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:3 (ESV): "For Jesus has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses—as much more glory as the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself."

questions.question: (For every house is built by someone, but the builder of all things is ____.)
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:4 (ESV): "(For every house is built by someone, but the builder of all things is God.)"

questions.question: Now Moses was faithful in all God's house as a ____, to testify to the things that were to be spoken later,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:5 (ESV): "Now Moses was faithful in all God's house as a servant, to testify to the things that were to be spoken later,"

questions.question: but Christ is faithful over God's house as a ____. And we are his house, if indeed we hold fast our confidence and our boasting in our hope.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:6 (ESV): "but Christ is faithful over God's house as a son. And we are his house, if indeed we hold fast our confidence and our boasting in our hope."

questions.question: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, "Today, if you hear his voice, do not ____ your hearts as in the rebellion,"
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:7-8 (ESV): "Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, 'Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, on the day of testing in the wilderness,'"

questions.question: where your fathers put me to the test and saw my works for ____ years.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:9 (ESV): "where your fathers put me to the test and saw my works for forty years."

questions.question: Therefore I was provoked with that generation, and said, 'They always go astray in their heart; they have not known my ____.'
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:10 (ESV): "Therefore I was provoked with that generation, and said, 'They always go astray in their heart; they have not known my ways.'"

questions.question: As I swore in my wrath, 'They shall not enter my ____.'
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:11 (ESV): "As I swore in my wrath, 'They shall not enter my rest.'"

questions.question: Take care, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil, unbelieving heart, leading you to fall away from the ____ God.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:12 (ESV): "Take care, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil, unbelieving heart, leading you to fall away from the living God."

questions.question: But exhort one another every day, as long as it is called "today," that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:13 (ESV): "But exhort one another every day, as long as it is called 'today,' that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin."

questions.question: For we have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original ____ firm to the end.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:14 (ESV): "For we have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original confidence firm to the end."

questions.question: For who were those who heard and yet rebelled? Was it not all those who left Egypt led by ____?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:16 (ESV): "For who were those who heard and yet rebelled? Was it not all those who left Egypt led by Moses?"

questions.question: So we see that they were unable to enter because of ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 3:19 (ESV): "So we see that they were unable to enter because of unbelief."

key_verse_text: Take care, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil, unbelieving heart, leading you to fall away from the living God. But exhort one another every day, as long as it is called "today," that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
